meta.name: elevenlabs-tts
meta.description: ElevenLabs text-to-speech with 22+ premium voices, multilingual support, and voice tuning via inference.sh CLI. Models: eleven_multilingual_v2 (highest quality), eleven_turbo_v2_5 (low latency), eleven_flash_v2_5 (ultra-fast). Capabilities: text-to-speech, voice selection, stability/style control, 32 languages. Use for: voiceovers, audiobooks, video narration, podcasts, accessibility, IVR. Triggers: elevenlabs, eleven labs, elevenlabs tts, premium tts, professional voice, ai voice, high quality tts, multilingual tts, eleven labs voice, voice generation, natural speech, realistic voice, voice over, speech synthesis

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文字转为逼真的多语言语音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要高质量多语言语音合成
copy.tagline_en: Convert text into realistic multilingual speech
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-quality multilingual speech synthesis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过命令行调用 ElevenLabs 的 22 种以上语音，将文字转为语音，支持多语言、模型选择和音色微调。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成语音、配音或朗读文本，并提到“elevenlabs”、“语音合成”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 aria 语音朗读“欢迎使用我们的产品”。
say.note: 生成一段美式英语语音。

say.text: 用 george 语音生成一段英式英语配音。

say.note: 使用多语言模型生成西班牙语语音。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call the ElevenLabs TTS via CLI to convert text to speech using 22+ voices, with multilingual support, model selection, and voice tuning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for voice generation, narration, or text-to-speech, mentioning keywords like 'elevenlabs', 'voice synthesis', etc.

say_en.text: Read 'Welcome to our product' with voice aria.
Generate a British English voiceover with voice george.
